Name: Caffe Cordina

Company description: Caffe Cordina is a company with a long and prestigious history. Founded in 1837, the Cordina family started off from a small outlet in Bormla, which shop started to specialize in the baking and preparation of traditional Maltese sweet delicacies, defining the Cordina family’s true vocation. A vocation nourished by courageous decisions, such as the relocation of the coffee shop to Valletta in 1944 by the the late Mr Cesare Cordina, forefather of the present family. Over the years he enlarged the establishment resulting in the Caffe you see before you today comprising of tea rooms, pasticceria, coffee bar and gelateria.    In the meantime, the company had the capacity of transforming itself into one of the most reputable coffee shops in Malta: a success which gives its thanks to the continual search for quality, a quality much appreciated by the real gourmet, be it a local or a tourist visiting the islands, that has recognized Caffe Cordina for more than a century.     In addition to its coffee shop, the Cordina family has ventured into other related fields of business. This includes its outside catering business, falling under the Cordina Outside Catering brand, a business venture that for the last 4 decades has set itself as a pioneer in the production and presentation of gastronomical delicacies for outside catering purposes.     Cordina also produce its own product lines of Maltese delicacies, covering gourmet products and sweets. Still made in the traditional way, these are available for takeaway at selected outlets throughout Malta and Gozo as well as at the Malta International Airport.     Today, with its flagship coffee shop in Valletta, its Outside Catering business and its gourmet and sweet product lines, the Company faces the future confidently, aiming at diversification and international growth.

The industry, then just a fledgling, desperately required unity of purpose and strategy. The newly formed Association sought incessantly to direct successive administrations towards recognising the benefits of a successful tourism industry.  It also worked hard in the interests of its members, who required the umbrella protection of a strong and cohesive union to represent them. The attainment of Independence in 1964 heralded a wave of confidence in the Island’s potential as a holiday destination.  The MHRA was not slow to seize upon the opportunity to press for improvements in its industry.  Hotels started sprouting throughout our Islands and the number of beds trebled.  The increase in the number of restaurants was commensurate to the increase in tourists and the prosperity of the locals. Today, MHRA has also a good number of Associate Partners whose activities are closely linked to the Tourism Sector.   Their support is invaluable in sustaining MHRA as a strong lobby group to ensure the growth of the tourism activity.  Besides, they  benefit from a number of incentives to improve their particular business.    The Tourism Industry is today considered all over the world as the motor behind each country’s economy and therefore it operators is highly competitive market place.    Malta needs to be proactive to continue to build a sustainable tourism industry and this can only be achieved through unity of all the players in the Industry working in harmony to reach the required growth through a common goal.   MHRA aims to achieve this goal.

All that is known is that the building dates back to the early 1600s when Valletta was being crafted by the finest European architects and engineers of the day. The building itself has been in good company over the years – Palazzo Carafa next door was home to Knights of St John Grandmaster Gregorio Carafa, and this early Baroque palace was used to accommodate his key employees and friends. Today, The Coleridge reflects the former glory that this building would have enjoyed – from the striking design of the unique rooms and suites to the excellent facilities available throughout. It provides the ideal location from which to visit this UNESCO World Heritage City, to enjoy its dynamic cultural and historic offerings, and to work within Valletta’s historic bastion walls.

Company description: Travelling through Sicily and grasp the essence of the island. Each place has a story to tell, an experience to put forward. Nature excursions such as trekking and mountain biking through the paths of the highest volcano in Europe,and Sicily unknown inside The Modonie Park  and Etna excursions.  Sport activities, sailing between the wonderful Eolie Islands and then golf, excursions and trekking with donkeys and hourses,  for those who intend to relax and enjoy nature. Wedding: We specialize in the organization of Destination Weddings in Sicily, and it goes without saying that  one of the fomous  destination choice is the world famous picturesque town of  Cefalù with its cathedral, the  characteristic fishing port is also a charming location for a wedding in Sicily. Shopping in Sicily: Food & Wine, Art & Crafts, Fashion & Accessories in the biggest commercial Structure in Catania, Enna and Palermo. For any transport’s need HRW TRAVEL provides the clients with a wide range of options: those who choose freedom and prefer to move on their own can rent reliable cars at the cheapest prices of the moment. HRW TRAVEL’s clients can also choose among buses and mini-buses thanks to the partnership with bus company.
